name: Mahou Shoujo Platinum Teruru-chan
original_name: 魔法少女 ぷらちなてるるちゃん
source:
Tounomori Iota had a certain problem during his summer vacation.
It concerns Teruru-chan, who recently started staying at his house.
She is an outrageous magical girl with no noble purpose or goal in mind, and she does all sorts of naughty things whenever and wherever she goes.

Even his older sister Rin, who was initially just watching over them, can't help but join in, and every day the Tounomori family is in a state of sexual mayhem!

[translated from [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/airrip/platinumteruru/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
Tounomori Iota在暑假期间遇到了一些问题。
事情涉及最近开始住在他家的照鲁酱。
她是一个没有任何崇高目标的令人发指的魔法少女，无论何时何地都会做出各种顽皮的事情。

就连原本只是在一旁看着的姐姐凛也忍不住加入进来，东森一家每天都处于性混乱的状态！

[翻译自[url=http://www.sp-janis.com/airrip/platinumteruru/story.html]官网[/url]]
